scientific_integrity: Proof of finite-moment uniqueness and sharp lower bound is analytic; symbolic identities and quadratures are reproducibility checks, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate right circular cylinders and exact isotropic scalar width moments; later 2026 companion paper was available only at abstract level; no independently certified priority, no optimized stability constants.
title: Sharp three-moment tomography of right circular cylinders
